decision: Neither prototype establishes a concurrent improvement. Runtime source restored; neither variant is enabled in the PR.
caveats: Local Apple M1/APFS host, changing background load. Interpret paired results, not cross-run absolute times.
Only cached synthetic creation is compared; cold baseline warm-up is not a cold before/after result.
Every sample is retained, including losses. Page-cache memory and in-flight kernel requests are not measured.

variants.description: Only change MAX_TREE_BYTES from 64 * 1024 * 1024 to 8 * 1024 * 1024; per-file limit stays 64 KiB.

Keep the 64 MiB byte budget. Add issuing: AtomicBool initialized false. At advise entry compare_exchange(false, true, Acquire, Relaxed); skip the optional hint on Err. Run the existing reservation and hint body, then store(false, Release). This limits issuing calls per process, not asynchronous kernel requests.
